jobs.occupation: Postdoc in Structural Biology of Protein Kinase Regulation by RNA Helicases (Biochemiker/in)
jobs.description:
The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.

The DKFZ is a place where the brightest minds pursue bold ideas and seek answers to pioneering scientific questions through collaboration, innovation, and exploration across many disciplines. We provide a dynamic environment which empowers excellence with state-of-the-art technologies, cutting edge infrastructure, and a global scientific network.

Contribute your knowledge, vision, and dedication to create a space where scientific discovery in cancer research is transformed into benefits for human health.

How cells communicate with their environment via cell-cell interactions and by growth factors is a key question in the molecular life sciences, including tumor biology. Wnt signaling plays an important role in embryonic development and cancer.

In the Division of Molecular Embryology (headed by Prof. Dr. Christof Niehrs), we study mechanisms of Wnt pathway regulation. To this end, we identify developmental control genes, investigate their biological role and biochemical mode of action, and examine how the genes are regulated.

To strengthen our team, we are seeking, starting at the earliest date possible, a Postdoc in Structural Biology of Protein Kinase Regulation by RNA Helicases.

Your Tasks

The Niehrs laboratory has identified DEAD-box RNA helicases as novel activators of protein kinases. In the context of Wnt-β-catenin signaling, DDX3 and CK1 cooperate and are both oncogenes. Understanding their regulatory interaction is therefore of considerable interest for the development of novel cancer therapeutics.

To unravel the mode of action whereby DDX3X activates CK1, you will solve and characterize the 3D structure of a DDX3-CK. To that end, you will produce recombinant DDX3X and CK1 proteins, purify and characterize their complexes using biochemical and biophysical methods. You will subject the kinase complexes to structural analysis using cryo-EM SPA or X-ray crystallography.

This project will be carried out in close collaboration between the laboratories of Prof. Dr. Irmgard Sinning at the University of Heidelberg and Prof. Dr. Christof Niehrs at the DKFZ. The postdoc will primarily work in the lab of Prof. Sinning and will receive training in a broad range of state-of-the-art techniques in structural biochemistry and biophysics.  

Techniques employed include recombinant protein production, FPLC, Western blotting, automated protein crystallization, single-particle cryo-EM (SPA), advanced X-ray structure determination using synchrotron radiation, AI-assisted protein modeling, hydrogen–deuterium exchange mass spectrometry (HDX-MS), microscale thermophoresis (MST), and isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC).

Your Profile

Applicants should hold a master's degree in molecular life sciences (e.g., biochemistry, biotechnology, molecular biology) with a background in recombinant protein work and/or structural biology. The applicant should be able to pursue research projects independently as well as in collaborations. Good written and oral command of English is essential.

Please submit a single PDF file including a CV (Germans: copies of Abitur & Masters degree), a cover letter stating your research and career interests, certificates, your expected availability date, and a list of publications, and attach two letters of reference.

Incomplete applications will not be considered or acknowledged.  

References:
Cruciat et al. (2013). RNA helicase DDX3 is a regulatory subunit of casein kinase 1 in Wnt-β-catenin signaling. Science 339, 1436-1441.

Fatti et al. (2023) DEAD-box RNA helicases act as nucleotide exchange factors for Casein Kinase 2. Science Signalling 16, eabp8923

Hirth et al. (2024) DEAD-box RNA helicases are pervasive protein kinase interactors and activators. Genome Res. 34, 952-966.

We Offer

- Excellent framework conditions: state-of-the-art equipment and opportunities for international networking at the highest level
- Remuneration according to TV-L incl. occupational pension plan and capital-forming payments
- 30 days of vacation per year
- Flexible working hours
- Possibility of part-time work
- Family-friendly working environment
- Sustainable travel to work: subsidized Germany job ticket
- Our Corporate Health Management Program offers a holistic approach to your well-being
- Develop your full potential: access to the DKFZ International Postdoc Program and DKFZ Career Service with targeted offers for your personal development to further develop your talents

Are you interested?

Then become part of the DKFZ and join us in contributing to a life without cancer!

Contact:

Prof. Dr. Christof Niehrs
Phone: +49 (0)6221-42 4690

Duration: The position is initially limited to 2 years with the possibility of prolongation.

Application Deadline: September 9, 2026

Applications by e-mail cannot be accepted.

Please also note that we cannot return applications submitted by post.

We are convinced that an innovative research and working environment thrives on the diversity of its employees. Therefore, we welcome applications from talented people, regardless of gender, cultural background, nationality, ethnicity, sexual identity, physical ability, religion and age. People with severe disabilities are given preference if they have the same aptitude.

- You identify opportunities, risks, and disruption signals (e.g., breakthrough therapies, patent cliffs) and provide proactive forecasts on competitor activities
- You conduct deep analyses of competitor pipelines, clinical trials, and technologies, developing competitive landscapes, scenario forecasts, and SWOT analyses

- You leverage advanced digital and AI-based tools e.g., perplexity to accelerate data analysis and enable continuous monitoring

- You hold a university degree, ideally PhD, MD, PharmD, or comparable in life sciences, complemented by long-term experience in the pharmaceutical industry, consulting, competitive intelligence, or strategy
- You bring substantial hands-on experience in oncology competitive intelligence, oncology R&D, or oncology portfolio strategy, with strong knowledge of key peers, emerging modalities, and major clinical and competitive trends
- You are skilled in using AI and digital tools as well as in analyzing scientific and competitive data sources
- You stand out with strong analytical, investigative, and creative thinking skills, combined with decisiveness and agility
- You are a strong team player, highly motivated, and able to work under pressure
- You have excellent communication, presentation, and networking skills and are confident in stakeholder management
- Excellent English language skills, both written and spoken, round off your profile

Our benefits package is flexible, appreciative, and tailored to your lifestyle, because: What matters to you, matters to us!

- We ensure your financial stability with a competitive salary between 109.800€ and 138.500€ per year (full-time) plus a variable component and a global equity-based cash plan. Your compensation is based on your qualifications, skills, and professional experience.
- Whether it’s hybrid work models or part-time arrangements: Whenever it is possible, you will have the flexibility to work how, when and where it is best for you.
- Your family is a top priority. We offer loving company daycare centers at multiple locations, support in finding childcare, time off for the care of elderly or dependent family members, summer camps for children, and much more.
- We support your professional growth by providing access to learning and development opportunities, training programs through the Bayer Learning Academy, development dialogues, as well as coaching and mentoring programs.
- We promote health awareness and opportunities for selfcare through various measures, such as free health checks with the company doctor.
- We emb  diversity by providing an inclusive work environment in which you are welcomed, supported, and encouraged to bring your whole self to work.

As this role requires regular in-person collaboration with key stakeholders and the team, candidates should be based within a reasonable commuting distance of Berlin. Physical presence at the Berlin office is expected, particularly during onboarding, for scheduled team meetings, and whenever business needs require face-to-face interaction.

Your mission
As an Agentic AI SDLC Architect, you will define and lead the architecture, operating model, and adoption strategy of the Agentic AI Software Development Lifecycle across SI Buildings Software & Digital Services (SDS), also known as Building X (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/products/building-x/?acz=1&gad_source=1&gad_campaignid=21916334080&gbraid=0AAAAADEuPPP8erijayyrni38fW3joeB_P&gclid=CjwKCAjwy5rUBhB5EiwAIoAtChYxWcHQcEzRaYur6ZNgWy2rJyS1CPyjOk5zAYNGbtsUalsW94TZjBoCEcIQAvD_BwE) .
This is a highly visible transformation role for a senior architect who wants to shape how AI, autonomous agents, and AI-native engineering practices are embedded across software and firmware development at enterprise scale.
You will establish the architectural foundations, governance model, standards, and engineering guardrails that enable the transition from traditional software development to an AI-native Software Factory. Working at the intersection of software architecture, platform engineering, DevSecOps, cybersecurity, AI governance, and product engineering, you will design the framework through which AI agents become trusted participants across the entire software lifecycle.
You will drive the evolution from isolated AI tools and copilots to a governed ecosystem of agentic capabilities spanning requirements engineering, architecture, implementation, quality engineering, security assurance, release management, operations, and continuous learning.
Your work will directly influence the future engineering operating model of SI Buildings and help create a scalable, secure, and measurable approach to AI-augmented product development.

Your new responsibilities
Agentic AI Engineering Strategy & Transformation

- Define and evolve the Agentic AI Engineering Strategy, target architecture, governance model, and adoption roadmap across SDS. - Align AI transformation initiatives with business objectives, product strategy, engineering priorities, and responsible AI principles. - Shape the future Software Factory operating model and drive the transition to AI-native engineering practices.

Agentic AI SDLC Architecture

- Design and own the architecture of the Agentic AI SDLC framework. - Define how AI agents participate across requirements, architecture, implementation, testing, security, compliance, deployment, operations, and feedback loops. - Develop reference architectures for human-in-the-loop, human-on-the-loop, and autonomous execution patterns.

Multi-Agent Systems & Orchestration

- Architect scalable multi-agent ecosystems capable of collaborating across engineering workflows. - Define orchestration patterns, agent communication standards, context-sharing mechanisms, memory management approaches, and execution guardrails. - Establish standards for agent lifecycle management, capability composition, and interoperability.

AI Governance, Trust & Compliance

- Define governance mechanisms that ensure traceability, auditability, explainability, observability, and accountability of agentic systems. - Embed responsible AI, cybersecurity, privacy, compliance, and regulatory requirements into architectural patterns and operational controls. - Establish measurable governance gates and continuous, evidence-based assurance models for AI-assisted software delivery.

AI Platform & Toolchain Integration

- Drive integration of AI capabilities into developer toolchains, CI/CD platforms, engineering workflows, cloud environments, and enterprise systems. - Define reusable platform services supporting AI agents, evaluation pipelines, retrieval systems, model gateways, knowledge services, and policy enforcement.

Evaluation & Continuous Learning

- Define evaluation frameworks and quality metrics for AI-assisted development and autonomous agent execution. - Establish mechanisms for measuring business impact, engineering productivity, quality improvements, risk reduction, and AI adoption maturity. - Continuously assess emerging technologies and incorporate applicable innovations into the framework roadmap.

Your talents and experience

- Education: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, artificial intelligence, software engineering, data science, or a related discipline.  - Experience & Skills:- Extensive experience in software architecture, enterprise architecture, platform engineering, DevSecOps, or engineering transformation leadership. - Proven experience designing enterprise-scale AI systems, generative AI platforms, LLM-based applications, multi-agent architectures, and AI-enabled engineering workflows. - Experience with agent orchestration frameworks, retrieval-augmented generation, knowledge systems, AI evaluation strategies, and AI governance frameworks. - Familiarity with responsible AI frameworks and relevant standards and regulations, including ISO 42001, ISO 27001, the EU AI Act, the Cyber Resilience Act, NIS2, and secure AI engineering practices. - Experience integrating AI capabilities across cloud environments, developer platforms, enterprise workflows, APIs, and software delivery toolchains.
- Ways of working: - Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and change leadership skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into practical engineering outcomes.  - Strong understanding of AI observability, agent reliability, evaluation methodologies, trust and safety mechanisms, and operational AI controls. - Strong understanding of modern software and firmware development lifecycles, platform engineering, DevSecOps, continuous delivery, and Software Factory concepts.
- Languages: Fluent in English.
